meaningEn: a form of address for a man
exampleEn: Mister Kim will be leading today's presentation.
exampleKr: 김 선생님이 오늘 발표를 진행할 것입니다.

meaningEn: a holiday or break from work
exampleEn: She is planning to take a two-week vacation in August.
exampleKr: 그녀는 8월에 2주간의 휴가를 계획하고 있습니다.

meaningEn: someone who pays for a service
exampleEn: The lawyer met with an important client this morning.
exampleKr: 변호사는 오늘 아침 중요한 고객을 만났습니다.

meaningEn: a digital version of a book that can be read on a computer or electronic device
exampleEn: You can download the e-book directly from our website.
exampleKr: 저희 웹사이트에서 전자책을 바로 다운로드하실 수 있습니다.

meaningEn: the place where you go to get on a plane
exampleEn: The shuttle bus leaves for the airport every hour.
exampleKr: 셔틀버스는 매시간 공항으로 출발합니다.

meaningEn: a written reminder to do something
exampleEn: Please read the memo about the new office policy.
exampleKr: 새로운 사무실 정책에 관한 메모를 읽어 주세요.

meaningEn: to put something on hold for use later, e.g. car, hotel room
exampleEn: I'd like to make a reservation for two people tonight.
exampleKr: 오늘 밤 두 명 예약을 하고 싶습니다.

meaningEn: to do with reason
exampleEn: Her argument was clear and logical.
exampleKr: 그녀의 주장은 명확하고 논리적이었습니다.

meaningEn: to send using a fax machine
exampleEn: Please fax the signed contract to our office by noon.
exampleKr: 서명된 계약서를 정오까지 저희 사무실로 팩스 보내 주세요.

meaningEn: the hour of the day
exampleEn: The meeting is scheduled for nine o'clock sharp.
exampleKr: 회의는 정각 9시로 예정되어 있습니다.

meaningEn: with honesty
exampleEn: We sincerely appreciate your continued support.
exampleKr: 귀하의 지속적인 지원에 진심으로 감사드립니다.

meaningEn: at some unknown point in time
exampleEn: Let's schedule a follow-up meeting sometime next week.
exampleKr: 다음 주 언젠가 후속 회의 일정을 잡읍시다.

meaningEn: the person who is in charge
exampleEn: Please report any issues to your supervisor immediately.
exampleKr: 문제가 발생하면 즉시 관리자에게 보고해 주세요.

meaningEn: give back money that has already been paid
exampleEn: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days.
exampleKr: 고객은 30일 이내에 전액 환불을 요청할 수 있습니다.

meaningEn: resources or things bought or sold
exampleEn: The warehouse stores goods before they are shipped.
exampleKr: 창고는 물품이 배송되기 전에 보관하는 곳입니다.

meaningEn: a building or room where things are made or repaired
exampleEn: All new employees must attend the training workshop.
exampleKr: 모든 신입 사원은 교육 워크숍에 참석해야 합니다.

meaningEn: the business or central part of a city or town
exampleEn: The new office building is located downtown.
exampleKr: 새 사무실 건물은 시내에 위치해 있습니다.

meaningEn: when something must be finished
exampleEn: The deadline for submitting the report is Friday.
exampleKr: 보고서 제출 마감 기한은 금요일입니다.

meaningEn: a written request for payment for the goods and services listed
exampleEn: Please send the invoice to the accounting department.
exampleKr: 청구서를 회계 부서로 보내 주세요.

meaningEn: a small paper book that gives information about a product or service
exampleEn: Take a brochure at the front desk for more details.
exampleKr: 자세한 내용은 안내 데스크에서 팸플릿을 가져가세요.

meaningEn: the middle of the day
exampleEn: The store closes for lunch at noon.
exampleKr: 그 가게는 정오에 점심시간으로 문을 닫습니다.

meaningEn: a person responsible for the money in a business
exampleEn: The accountant reviewed the company's annual budget.
exampleKr: 회계사가 회사의 연간 예산을 검토했습니다.

meaningEn: someone who works at a counter
exampleEn: The clerk helped me find the item I was looking for.
exampleKr: 점원이 제가 찾던 물건을 찾도록 도와주었습니다.

meaningEn: the main area of a hotel just inside the entrance
exampleEn: We'll meet in the hotel lobby at eight.
exampleKr: 8시에 호텔 로비에서 만납시다.

meaningEn: to print and distribute
exampleEn: The company will publish its financial results next week.
exampleKr: 그 회사는 다음 주에 재무 결과를 발표할 것입니다.

meaningEn: a short document listing a person's education, work experience, and skills
exampleEn: Please attach your résumé to the application email.
exampleKr: 지원 이메일에 이력서를 첨부해 주세요.

meaningEn: to surround fully
exampleEn: I have enclosed a copy of the receipt for your records.
exampleKr: 귀하의 기록을 위해 영수증 사본을 동봉했습니다.

meaningEn: a person who submits papers in order to do something, e.g. job applicant
exampleEn: Each applicant must submit a résumé and cover letter.
exampleKr: 각 지원자는 이력서와 자기소개서를 제출해야 합니다.

meaningEn: a discussion session or class led by a teacher, or expert
exampleEn: The marketing seminar will be held in Conference Room B.
exampleKr: 마케팅 세미나는 회의실 B에서 열릴 예정입니다.

meaningEn: someone who is trained with special skills to do practical work
exampleEn: A technician will arrive tomorrow to fix the printer.
exampleKr: 내일 기술자가 프린터를 고치러 방문할 것입니다.

meaningEn: a piece of thin material
exampleEn: Wipe the table with a clean cloth.
exampleKr: 깨끗한 천으로 테이블을 닦으세요.

meaningEn: the cost for a ride, e.g. bus, or taxi
exampleEn: The bus fare increased by fifty cents this month.
exampleKr: 이번 달에 버스 요금이 50센트 인상되었습니다.

meaningEn: proof of payment
exampleEn: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.
exampleKr: 물건을 반품해야 할 경우를 대비해 영수증을 보관하세요.

meaningEn: a tourist or adventurer who visits many countries
exampleEn: The airport was crowded with travelers during the holiday.
exampleKr: 연휴 동안 공항은 여행자들로 붐볐습니다.

meaningEn: the person that is phoning you
exampleEn: The receptionist asked the caller to hold for a moment.
exampleKr: 안내원은 전화 건 사람에게 잠시 기다려 달라고 요청했습니다.

meaningEn: a tunnel under the road for people to walk through
exampleEn: It's faster to take the subway during rush hour.
exampleKr: 출퇴근 시간에는 지하철을 타는 것이 더 빠릅니다.

meaningEn: Bags and cases that you carry your clothes in when you go on a journey
exampleEn: Please make sure your luggage is properly labeled.
exampleKr: 짐에 이름표가 제대로 붙어 있는지 확인해 주세요.

meaningEn: delivery of goods, e.g. carried by a large vehicle
exampleEn: The shipment is expected to arrive by Thursday.
exampleKr: 배송품은 목요일까지 도착할 예정입니다.

meaningEn: to guess something with given information
exampleEn: From the report, we can infer that sales are improving.
exampleKr: 보고서를 통해 매출이 개선되고 있다고 추론할 수 있습니다.

meaningEn: a man whose job it is to bring meals to your table in a restaurant or cafe
exampleEn: The waiter recommended the special of the day.
exampleKr: 웨이터가 오늘의 특선 메뉴를 추천해 주었습니다.

meaningEn: the act of paying for the use of something (as an apartment or house or car)
exampleEn: We arranged a car rental for our business trip.
exampleKr: 출장을 위해 렌터카를 예약했습니다.

meaningEn: the promise to repair or replace a product if it ceases to work properly
exampleEn: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
exampleKr: 이 노트북에는 2년 품질 보증이 제공됩니다.

meaningEn: a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
exampleEn: Employees can have lunch at the company cafeteria.
exampleKr: 직원들은 회사 구내식당에서 점심을 먹을 수 있습니다.

meaningEn: a person who cooks for a living
exampleEn: The restaurant hired a new head chef last month.
exampleKr: 그 식당은 지난달에 새로운 수석 요리사를 채용했습니다.

meaningEn: a machine that takes people to different floors in a building
exampleEn: The elevator is out of service, so please use the stairs.
exampleKr: 엘리베이터가 고장이니 계단을 이용해 주세요.

meaningEn: the act of greeting people
exampleEn: A reception will be held after the awards ceremony.
exampleKr: 시상식 후에 환영회가 열릴 예정입니다.

meaningEn: to do something the right way
exampleEn: Make sure the form is filled out correctly.
exampleKr: 양식이 올바르게 작성되었는지 확인하세요.

meaningEn: to rent
exampleEn: The company decided to lease office space downtown.
exampleKr: 회사는 시내에 사무 공간을 임대하기로 결정했습니다.

meaningEn: a vehicle with two wheels and pedals
exampleEn: Many employees ride a bicycle to work in the summer.
exampleKr: 여름에는 많은 직원들이 자전거로 출근합니다.

meaningEn: officially tell someone some information
exampleEn: We will notify you as soon as the order ships.
exampleKr: 주문 상품이 발송되는 즉시 알려드리겠습니다.
